Simulate a nonlinear model

Source: R/nonlinear.R
ctrl_nl_simulate.Rd

Continuous time models are integrated with deSolve (default method "lsoda", an adaptive stiff/nonstiff solver); discrete models are iterated. The input can be

Usage

ctrl_nl_simulate(
  sys,
  x0,
  times,
  input = NULL,
  controller = NULL,
  method = "lsoda",
  rtol = 1e-08,
  atol = 1e-10
)

Arguments

sys

A ctrl_nlsys model.

x0

Initial state.

times

Time points (for discrete models, sample indices are times / dt).

input

Input (see above) or NULL for zero input.

controller

Optional feedback law function(t, x).

method

deSolve integration method.

rtol, atol

Integration tolerances.

Value

An object of class ctrl_nl_response with time, x, u and y matrices.

Details

  • a vector or matrix with one row per time point, held constant between points (zero-order hold, integrated interval by interval);

  • a function input(t) evaluated continuously by the integrator;

  • a feedback law controller(t, x) evaluated at the time points and held in between, which simulates a sampled-data controller.

Examples

pendulum <- ctrl_nlsys(
  function(t, x, u, p) c(x[2], -9.81 * sin(x[1]) - 0.5 * x[2] + u),
  nstates = 2, ninputs = 1
)
sim <- ctrl_nl_simulate(pendulum, x0 = c(2, 0), times = seq(0, 10, 0.05))
plot(sim)
